features.name: zscore_age
features.description: Z-score normalized age using training set mean and std, enabling scale-normalized distance computation for age dimension
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes age to unit scale so KNN distance metric treats age proportionally to other features

features.name: zscore_duration
features.description: Z-score normalized call duration using training set mean and std, critical for KNN as duration has high variance
features.expected_model_benefit: Prevents duration from dominating KNN distance due to its large raw scale

features.name: zscore_euribor3m
features.description: Z-score normalized euribor 3-month rate using training set statistics
features.expected_model_benefit: Normalizes macroeconomic rate feature for balanced contribution to KNN distance

features.name: economic_conditions_score
features.description: Composite economic environment score combining employment variation rate, consumer price index deviation from mean, and euribor rate normalized values
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures macroeconomic context as a single dimension, improving neighborhood geometry for economically similar observations

features.name: contact_recency_score
features.description: Score reflecting recency and intensity of prior contact: penalizes high pdays (not recently contacted) and rewards previous contacts
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes contact history geometry so KNN finds neighbors with similar outreach patterns

features.name: log1p_duration_normalized
features.description: Log-transformed and normalized call duration to reduce right skew, improving distance metric behavior
features.expected_model_benefit: Log transformation reduces outlier influence on KNN distances for heavily skewed duration feature

features.name: campaign_intensity_normalized
features.description: Log-normalized campaign contact count to compress heavy tail and normalize for distance computation
features.expected_model_benefit: Reduces distortion from extreme campaign values in KNN distance calculations

features.name: financial_risk_profile
features.description: Composite financial risk indicator combining default status, housing loan, and personal loan encoded values
features.expected_model_benefit: Groups observations by financial obligation profile, creating meaningful clusters for KNN neighborhood structure

features.name: sociodemographic_distance_from_mean
features.description: Euclidean-like distance of sociodemographic features (age, education, job) from their training set means, normalized by standard deviations
features.expected_model_benefit: Measures how atypical a person is demographically, helping KNN identify outlier vs central observations

features.name: macroeconomic_distance_from_mean
features.description: Euclidean distance of macroeconomic indicators from their training means, normalized by standard deviations
features.expected_model_benefit: Captures how unusual the macroeconomic environment is for a given observation, improving KNN cluster separation

features.name: engagement_quality_score
features.description: Semantic assessment of overall engagement quality based on call duration, contact type, and previous outcome. Higher scores indicate stronger engagement signals: long duration with cellular contact and successful prior outcome score highest
features.expected_model_benefit: Provides a semantically meaningful cluster indicator that groups observations by engagement quality, improving KNN neighborhood coherence

features.name: temporal_campaign_context_score
features.description: Semantic score reflecting the temporal context of the campaign contact: considers month seasonality (spring/summer vs winter), day of week (mid-week vs Monday/Friday), and campaign recency. Scores range from 0 (poor timing context) to 10 (optimal timing context)
features.expected_model_benefit: Encodes temporal patterns into a single dimension that helps KNN identify observations contacted under similar temporal circumstances
